svg.title: Adding the waves together
svg.desc: Left: top-down view of the 16 wave directions made by the controller with its default values; solid arrows are the travelling waves, dashed arrows the weaker opposite waves, length shows amplitude. Right/below: a slice of the summed surface along the wind direction.
svg.text: long, spread over 90° around the wind.
Dashed: the same wave sent the opposite
way (40 %, Q × 0.7): it partly stands still.
